audit_items.proof_trace: The handler processes blob_sidecars_by_root requests without checking if current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. After this threshold, the RPC endpoint should respond with empty or reject per spec, but the implementation continues serving blobs normally, violating the deprecation requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS, an attacker can send blob_sidecars_by_root requests and receive valid responses instead of empty/reject, causing nodes to incorrectly serve deprecated protocol messages and potentially maintain dual state (blobs + data columns) longer than specified, increasing resource consumption and network divergence.
